# GPTgrep project navigation

- [Project authority](AGENTS.md): implementation, verification, review and delivery.
- [Product specification](SPEC.md): interfaces, initial release and long-horizon research goal.
- [Goal contract](workspace/harness-config/goal-contract.json): live PageIndex comparison gates; a preview release alone does not meet them.
- Local research gaps: `workspace/issues/research-gaps.json` (ignored and untracked).
- Local execution plans: `workspace/exec-plans/` (ignored and untracked).
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): parsing, trees, trigram filtering, Jev and the local Codex host.
- [PTC multimodal design](docs/design/ptc-multimodal-retrieval.md): proposed batch retrieval, Luna Decisions, rich parsing and Agentic OCR; implementation and release gates remain pending.
- Local research entry: `docs/research/README.md` (ignored and untracked).
- [Flash stage coverage](crates/gptgrep-pageindex/FLASH_STAGE_COVERAGE.md): verified port stages, LiteParse alternatives and pending parity.
- Local paired plan: `docs/research/paired-baseline-plan.md` (ignored and untracked).
- [Baseline runner](scripts/pageindex_baseline/README.md): reproducible controls, execution and accounting.
- [Local host defaults](config/codex-host.toml): gpt-5.6-luna / max; account selected at runtime.
- [Release workflow](docs/release.md): source binding, native dependency notices and relocation.

Private continuation evidence lives under `.local/runs/`; exact source revision,
native identities and run receipt hashes belong there and in private Git PoUW
notes. Read the current source and exact selected checkpoint before continuing.
